lines.text: 杰克在跟一位巴西客户谈一笔大订单，巴西跟北京有十一个小时的时差，两个人很难同时醒着。

lines.en: Jack is negotiating a big order with a client in Brazil. There's an eleven-hour time difference between Brazil and Beijing, so the two of them are rarely awake at the same time.
